messages:
Omari Santos: Morning team! I’m Omari — joined today as an SRE on infra. Laptop showed up (thank you logistics) but I’m stuck at the MDM step. Who should I ping for Okta groups/VPN access? Also quick intro: I brew terrible kombucha and code at odd hours :wave:

Julie Kim: welcome Omari!! :tada: Tagging Sam from IT — he'll sort your access. Also swing by #random when you have stickers questions :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Sam W.: hey @Omari — congrats and welcome. I can take this. Can you paste the device serial (on the underside) and confirm macOS or Linux? I'll trigger Okta group add and VPN cert.

Omari Santos: macOS Ventura 13.4, serial is C02ZL1N4JY2H. I ran the enrollment but it errors with "profile install failed".

Sam W.: got it. Try running this from Terminal and paste output if it still fails:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/company-mdm enroll --serial C02ZL1N4JY2H
/Applications/CompanyMDM.app/Contents/MacOS/CompanyMDM enroll
```

Omari Santos: ran the first command — prompt for sudo, entered it. Output: "enroll: profile signed by unknown authority (0x6a)."

MDM Bot: Device serial C02ZL1N4JY2H found in provisioning. Current status: enrollment_failed. Ticket #IT-2147 opened. Assigned to Sam W. ETA 2 business hours.

Sam W.: thanks — looks like your cert chain didn’t fetch. I’ll push a manual profile and add you to the "infra-sre" Okta group. In the meantime, here's the jumpbox key setup you can try once I finish: 
```
mkdir -p ~/.ssh && ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/redwood_id_ed25519 -C "omari@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/redwood_id_ed25519.pub | ssh your-username@jump.redwood.com 'mkdir -p ~/.ssh && cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys'
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_id_ed25519 omari@jump.redwood.com
```

Katie Liu: welcome! if you want a mentor for the week ping me — happy to do a 30m sync on services and runbooks.

Tara H.: Omari — congrats. When you’re free later I’ll add you to the #oncall-rotation doc and show the pagerflow. No pressure first week.

Marc B.: also sending a small swag pack from People Ops — expect a hoodie and stickers. People Ops will confirm shipping.

People Ops: Hey @Omari — hoodie size? We have S/M/L/XL. Also do you want the coffee kit or bug zapper? :smile:

Omari Santos: hoodie M please, coffee kit all the way. Appreciate everyone — see you on the infra intro call at 2pm.

Julie Kim: see you there! :rocket:
